description: Source-of-truth for the Gitwork-owned starter library. `mirror` entries are permissively licensed (MIT/Apache-2.0) and safe to vendor with their LICENSE retained. `excluded` entries are NOT mirrored for the stated licence reason and are rewritten Gitwork-native instead. `noSource` starters have no single upstream. Keyed by starter slug; a slug may map to several repos (subfoldered under the slug).

excluded.reason: Curated index of external links, not code; GitHub detects Apache but there's no LICENSE file to vendor. Low mirror value — keep link-only / curate our own.
No licence = all rights reserved; cannot redistribute. Rewrite Gitwork-native (it's just a curated index).
No licence = all rights reserved; cannot redistribute. Rewrite Gitwork-native.
Non-commercial licence; Foundry is commercial. Rewrite Gitwork-native.
Copyleft; incompatible with proprietary use. Dropped — Ship It's other three sources are MIT.

noSource.reason: Authored in-house by Gitwork — nothing to mirror.
Official Claude Code marketplace partners (Figma/Playwright/Vercel/Supabase/Linear/Sentry/Stripe) — no single repo.
